new_hypothesis.name: deployer_second_launch_buyer_reflex
new_hypothesis.mechanism: When a wallet has previously deployed a Solana SPL token that reached >=$500k peak FDV with >=$50k cumulative volume (a 'hit deployer'), the 10 earliest-buyer wallets of that hit token form a 'buyer-reflex pool'. When the SAME deployer launches a NEW token, >=3 of those reflex-pool wallets typically re-enter within 30-120s. Their re-entry creates a self-fulfilling early-volume spike that triggers DexScreener trending and retail FOMO, producing a 2-8x in the first 5-15 minutes before reflex-pool wallets exit. Bot enters alongside the reflex pool, exits before retail saturation.
new_hypothesis.persistence: Sniper UIs (Axiom, GMGN) show only the deployer's prior-token performance as a scalar metric, NOT the buyer-graph crossover. Computing 'did >=3 wallets from deployer's prior-hit-token early-buyer set just buy this new mint?' requires graph traversal (deployer -> tx -> token list -> per-token early-buyer set -> intersection), which retail snipers do not do because it requires persistent indexed history. Competitors cannot easily reproduce without per-deployer state.
new_hypothesis.entry_rules: Step 1: detect new mint (Pump.fun/letsBONK/Bags listeners). Step 2: resolve deployer = first signer of mint init tx. Step 3: query deployer's prior mints via Alchemy getSignaturesForAddress + getTransaction parse. Step 4: filter to prior mints with peak FDV >= $500k AND cumulative volume >= $50k (DexScreener history); need >=1 hit token. Step 5: extract earliest-10 buyer wallets per hit token -> union set = 'reflex pool'. Step 6: monitor first 120s of new-mint trades. Step 7: if >=3 reflex-pool wallets buy within 120s, FIRE buy at 3% size. Stop 8%, trailing activates at +20% (faster than default +10% because reflex pumps decay quicker), 15-min hard time-limit.
new_hypothesis.data_required: Alchemy Solana RPC (already configured): getSignaturesForAddress, getTransaction. DexScreener historical price for FDV peak (already integrated). New persistent cache: deployer_reflex_pool.json (keyed by deployer wallet -> reflex-pool wallet set, rebuilt weekly).
new_hypothesis.evidence: Three converging sources: (1) Medallion Analytics on-chain study (May 2025) of 178,109 prolific Solana deployers found 85.3% (151,893) cluster into a profitable-serial-deployer cohort responsible for ~3.07M token launches -> deployer identity is a strong non-random prior. (2) Axiom production trading terminal exposes 'deployer prior launches and their performance' as a live filter snipers gate on, confirming the signal is actionable at sub-minute timescale (DEXTools 2026 tutorial). (3) This repo's own pinned/target wallet discovery (sol_pinned_wallets.json, sol_target_wallets.json) empirically discovers ~23 alpha wallets via post-pump backtracing -- those wallets ARE the reflex-pool wallets, but the bot currently tracks them by identity not by causal link to deployer.
